blocks.text: ULAANBAATAR, Mongolia — Mongolia’s President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh announced his resignation on Tuesday following corruption allegations and impeachment threats from the country’s opposition party. His resignation announcement comes a day after the opposition Democratic Party issued a statement accusing him of graft and calling for him to step down or face impeachment in parliament.
